notes: Source: ventPay config/ventpay.php `alerts` (owner decision D3, 2026-10-26; HUMAN-QUEUE #26, #99) and app/Modules/Platform/Application/Alerts/SendOperatorAlert.php. ventPay has no docs/integration/ventmail-templates.json yet; this file is the reference until it does.

ventPay sends `template=ventpay.operator_alert` with no locale suffix and no o:channel (= transactional), with its own API key (workspace `venture`). The stored name is therefore fixed (`name`), and the one template is bilingual: Hungarian first, English below — the set carries a single manifest locale (hu).
ventPay always sends its own subject (`[ventPay] alarm: <name> (<mode>)` / `[ventPay] job failed: ...`); the request subject wins, the template subject is only the fallback.
Identifiers only, never personal data or a payload: an alert mail is read, forwarded and kept in an inbox.

templates.name: ventpay.operator_alert
templates.purpose: Something in ventPay a person has to look at: an outbox alarm (outcome unknown, refund contradicted, money after close …), a failed scheduled task, a dead-lettered outbox event or a token order that needs a person.

variables.alert_name: string — the alarm's / event's name (e.g. payment.outcome_unknown) or the failed task
variables.reference: string — the outbox row or the exception class it points at; empty when there is none
variables.tenant_id: string — the ventPay tenant's identifier; empty for a deployment-wide alert
variables.mode: string — live | test; empty for a deployment-wide alert
variables.admin_url: string — the ventPay admin's base URL (APP_URL)
